docs.purpose: Stores one user lot-size entry for one lot, once (D-1 a): its own record that wins over the City value for every viewer; the City value stays. Closed while the entry switch is off (403 ENTRY_OFF, D-6).
docs.data_story: It reads the switch and settings, then the lot and its active entry, checks the D-2 range and the D-3 City ratio on the server, and inserts one parcel_user_inputs row (source user, entered_at) in one transaction.
docs.under_126: A MUTATION CONTRACT; idempotency by the partial unique index (a second entry or a lost race is 409 with the stored entry).

classes.ui: Sign in again; nothing is stored.
ENTRY_OFF (the switch is off; the sheet is hidden, so a client never sees it) or SUBSCRIPTION_REQUIRED.
OUT_OF_RANGE or FAR_FROM_CITY_RECORD with the server-formatted message in the typed unit; VALIDATION_FAILED for a bad body.
LOT_SIZE_ALREADY_ENTERED with the stored entry in details.lot_size: the page treats it as entered and re-reads.
RATE_LIMITED: the entries a day are used up (D-4).
The form error state from content; the request is logged without the body.

emits.why: The entry row is its own record (who, when); the route logs outcome lines only.

offers.why: A write endpoint renders no sponsored placement.

metering.why: An entry is not a metered report view; it is limited per day by the rate limit (D-4).

config.why: The switch, the range, the City ratio and the entries a day are logic variables read by the route.

logic_variables.name: user_lot_size_entry_enabled
logic_variables.why: Write-gating: anything but 1 inside the seed bounds reads off (D-6).

logic_variables.name: user_lot_size_min_sqm
logic_variables.why: Write-affecting (D-2): a bad value refuses the entry rather than widen it.

logic_variables.name: user_lot_size_city_ratio_max
logic_variables.why: Write-affecting (D-3); max 10 keeps the 10.76x sq ft-as-m2 slip refused (OUTPUT fold S-2).

sharing.why: Called by the Add lot size form only (mounted at the flip).
